headline: Public hearings on a Mixed Use District text amendment, a gas station and convenience store at 124 Church St, and a site plan at 110 Leigus Rd.
summary: The Commission will hold public hearings on a zoning text amendment, a gas station and convenience store proposal, and a site plan under CT General Statute 8-30g. The agenda also includes other site plan approvals, a bond release, administrative approvals, and staff reports.
items: Text Amendment request for Quinnipiac Valley Growth Partners to add cannabis retailer as an allowed use by Special Permit in the RF-40 (Route 5) Zoning District, altering Sections §1.4, §6.34, and §4.16.C (#504-26) (Withdrawn)
Text Amendment request for KSCGH Partners, LLC to add new section §4.27 'Mixed Use (MU) District' floating zone to the Zoning Regulations (#505-26)

Special Permit request for Atlantis Management Group to demolish an existing building and construct a gas station with a 4,500± sq. ft. drive through retail and convenience store at 124 Church St. in the I-40 (Industrial) District (#407-26)
CT General Statute 8-30g Site Plan for The Metro Realty Management Corp. at 110 Leigus Rd. (#221-26)
Site Plan for Times Microwave Systems at 358 Hall Avenue (#224-26) - No action, continued to 11/16/2026
Site Plan for Prime Bay Rentals, LLC at 60 Carpenter Lane, Light Warehousing (#212-26)
Bond Release for McNulty at 25 Wall Street
Administrative Approvals: 59 North Elm St/Choate Rosemary Hall (#222-26), 824 East Center St. Unit A/Espinoza (#315-26), 1181 Barnes Rd/Laclair (#223-26), 480 North Colony Rd/Porto (#225-26)
